atomicity.reason: A single obligation - drive both coil outputs de-energised within a stated deadline - with no second clause that would stand alone.

comprehensibility.reason: Intelligible on its own; open command, coil channel outputs and de-energised level need no adjacent requirement.

feasibility.reason: A 10 ms output drive is far above the switching time of low-side coil drivers and is consistent with the 50 ms reaction budget the parent cites.

parent_fit.reason: ARCH_CONTACTOR_ACTUATOR owns translating the supervisor's open command into a coil de-energise within one 10 ms cycle; this requirement pins exactly that latency on both coil channels.

unambiguity.reason: One reading: both channels, de-energised level, 10 ms from assertion, with the start and end of the interval defined.

verifiability.reason: The requirement names its own measurement method (asserting-call timestamp to the timestamp at which both outputs read de-energised), so the test needs no interpretation.

summary: Full marks: one obligation, an explicit deadline, and the measurement method for that deadline spelled out. Note for the stage as a whole that the parent's FAULT_LATCHED behaviour (unconditional off, ignore close requests) has no swreq of its own.
